# testing_x_globals (Resource)

XGlobals Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_globals" "my_xglobals" {
  global_boolean              = true
  global_boolean_with_default = true
  global_enum_float32         = 1.2
  global_enum_float64         = 1.2
  global_enum_int32           = 1
  global_enum_int64           = 3
  global_enum_integer         = 5
  global_enum_number          = 1.2
  global_enum_string          = "value1"
  global_float32              = 1.2
  global_float32_with_default = 1.2
  global_float64              = 3.4
  global_float64_with_default = 3.4
  global_int32                = 12
  global_int32_with_default   = 12
  global_int64                = 34
  global_int64_with_default   = 34
  global_integer              = 56
  global_integer_with_default = 56
  global_number               = 5.6
  global_number_with_default  = 5.6
  global_string               = "global_string_example"
  global_string_with_default  = "DEFAULT"
  local_string                = "...my_local_string..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `global_boolean` (Boolean) x-speakeasy-globals defined global boolean
- `global_boolean_with_default` (Boolean) x-speakeasy-globals defined global boolean with default (true)
- `global_enum_float32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum float32 [1.2, 3.4]
- `global_enum_float64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum float64 [1.2, 3.4]
- `global_enum_int32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum int32 [1, 2]. must be one of [1, 2]
- `global_enum_int64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum int64 [3, 4]. must be one of [3, 4]
- `global_enum_integer` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum integer [5, 6]. must be one of [5, 6]
- `global_enum_number` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum number [1.2, 3.4]
- `global_enum_string` (String) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum string [value1, value2]. must be one of ["value1", "value2"]
- `global_float32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float32
- `global_float32_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float32 with default (1.2)
- `global_float64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float64
- `global_float64_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float64 with default (3.4)
- `global_int32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int32
- `global_int32_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int32 with default (12)
- `global_int64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int64
- `global_int64_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int64 with default (34)
- `global_integer` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global integer
- `global_integer_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global integer with default (56)
- `global_number` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global number
- `global_number_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global number with default (5.6)
- `global_string` (String) x-speakeasy-globals defined global string
- `global_string_with_default` (String) x-speakeasy-globals defined global string with default (DEFAULT)
- `local_string` (String)

### Read-Only

- `local_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_globals.my_testing_x_globals
  id = jsonencode({
    global_boolean              = true
    global_boolean_with_default = false
    global_enum_float32         = 1.2
    global_enum_float64         = 1.2
    global_enum_int32           = 1
    global_enum_int64           = 3
    global_enum_integer         = 5
    global_enum_number          = 1.2
    global_enum_string          = "value1"
    global_float32              = 1.2
    global_float32_with_default = 0.0
    global_float64              = 3.4
    global_float64_with_default = 0.0
    global_int32                = 12
    global_int32_with_default   = 0
    global_int64                = 34
    global_int64_with_default   = 0
    global_integer              = 56
    global_integer_with_default = 0
    global_number               = 5.6
    global_number_with_default  = 0.0
    global_string               = "global_string_example"
    global_string_with_default  = "..."
    local_id                    = "local_id_example"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_globals.my_testing_x_globals '{"global_boolean": true, "global_boolean_with_default": false, "global_enum_float32": 1.2, "global_enum_float64": 1.2, "global_enum_int32": 1, "global_enum_int64": 3, "global_enum_integer": 5, "global_enum_number": 1.2, "global_enum_string": "value1", "global_float32": 1.2, "global_float32_with_default": 0.0, "global_float64": 3.4, "global_float64_with_default": 0.0, "global_int32": 12, "global_int32_with_default": 0, "global_int64": 34, "global_int64_with_default": 0, "global_integer": 56, "global_integer_with_default": 0, "global_number": 5.6, "global_number_with_default": 0.0, "global_string": "global_string_example", "global_string_with_default": "...", "local_id": "local_id_example"}'
```
